leadText: The Electric Princess team (Japanese: エレキプリンセス Electric Princess) are minor characters who appeared in Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon.
plainText:
The Electric Princess team (Japanese: エレキプリンセス Electric Princess) are minor characters who appeared in Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon.

==History==
They first appeared in Mounting an Electrifying Charge!, as a group of girls who entered the Charjabug race with a belonging to one of them. They raced against , , and , who had entered with Sophocles's Charjabug; and , who disguised as a Charjabug. They managed to do very well during the race and went head to head with the Red Comet team and the Sophocles Lab team. However, during the last section, which involved an icy underground, the team's Charjabug slipped and nearly crashed into Sophocles's Charjabug. Ash jumped in the way and took the hit, causing their racing car to break. With this, the Electric Princess team was eliminated from the race, but they were still rewarded third place by default.

One of the girls reappeared in A High-Speed Awakening!. She was one of the competitors in the Vikavolt race, using her evolved , but ended up losing.
